name: Community Nursing
shortDescription: Professional community nursing care delivered at home for people who need disability-related health support.
plainEnglishSummary: If your disability means you need nursing care at home, the Community Nursing team may help with health assessments, wound care, continence support, diabetes management, medication and other health needs.
audience: People with disability who need nursing care at home
NDIS participants with relevant Core Supports funding
People needing help managing an ongoing health care plan
availabilityNote: Service availability, visit times, costs and service areas depend on the person's assessed nursing needs, clinician availability and funding arrangements. Disability-related nursing may be funded through the Disability Related Health Supports category of an eligible NDIS Core Supports budget.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm clinical suitability, NDIS funding or service availability. Contact DHS Disability Services to discuss nursing needs, location, funding and whether Community Nursing is appropriate. Seek urgent medical assistance through the appropriate emergency service when immediate care is required.
